title: lucas' cappuccino
steps: for espsresso base: 30s bloom, stir for 30 seconds
4:30 brew, then immediately plunge and serve the espreso base
heat 150ml of milk to around 60C, then pour to french press
pump with the plunger: 3-5 high presses, 20 low presses
pour the frothed milk over the espresso base (latte art optional)
